author: MonkMoris
quote:
Shameful corruption of GTA's original message and incredibly unaware of itself.
Lucia and Jason are bland compared to previous protagonists, the story is a huge letdown and nowhere close to rdr2 or other GTA's. Woke political agenda forced upon you that restricts parts of the freedom other GTA's gave you, 30 fps cap, tons of bugs and an ending that isn t really memorable. 
This game isn t worth the 80-100 dollars pricetag and it wasn t worth the wait.
